records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Cedar Collective!
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Following up after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for making time for the kickoff last week. Picking up where we left off: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project and adding a few tasks is usually the quickest way to see how it fits Cedar Collective's work.

Would a short call this week suit? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you so you're not starting from a blank page. If you'd rather sort it by email, just tell me what your team is tracking and I'll help from there.

Best,
Nadia
